advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.title: Benefits Specialist
advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.description: Founded in 1985, ATS is a company with a presence in the United States, Mexico and the United Kingdom. We are professionals in Industrial Maintenance and we make factories run better. Fundada en 1985, ATS es una empresa con presencia en los Estados Unidos, México y el Reino Unido. Somos profesionales en mantenimiento industrial y hacemos que las fábricas funcionen mejor. Principal Duties/Responsibilities: Maintain annual Salary Administration Guidelines. Assists in the design and administration of variable pay programs, including management incentives. Serves as a consultant to managers and HR team members on compensation and benefit related topics. Presents training for compensation and benefit related topics and tools. Researches best compensation and benefit practices, regulations and compliances; provides analysis and recommendations. Participates in professional, external compensation and benefit surveys. Responds to escalated compensation and benefit inquiries from employees and leaders. Collaborates with leadership and vendors to coordinate, develop, and maintain compensation and benefit programs. Administers the annual open enrollment process. Collaborates with leadership on the development and distribution of effective communication and training materials to ensure awareness of benefit program updates and opportunities. Maintains benefit processes and employee records in HRIS. Verifies accuracy of payroll deductions and benefits-related data. Produces and analyzes metrics and reports to provide information on benefit utilization and cost. Evaluates the cost impact of changes to base pay rates, incentive programs, or benefits packages. Acts as a lead and provides coaching and or mentoring to entry level team members. Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (KSAs), & Competencies: Essential KSAs: Bachelor’s Degree in related field and five years’ experience in corporate compensation and benefits. Strong analytical skills. Demonstrated ability to problem solve and work through complex issues. Strong presentation skills. Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Knowledge of government regulations as they apply to benefits and retirement programs. Desirable KSAs: HRIS experience Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) Certification Certified Employee Benefits Specialist (CEBS) Certification Competencies: Interpreting Information / Analysis Presentation Skills Communication Attention to Detail Teamwork Physical Demands and Working Conditions: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands/fingers to handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch; and talk or hear. The employee is also required to use a telephone with headset for verbal troubleshooting, frequent use of a standard keyboard and computer to document calls in a ticketing system, and occasional use of other office equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move more than 30 pounds. The employee is occasionally required to sit for long periods and use close and color vision. Work is typically performed in a moderately noisy business office. ATS believes in fair and equitable pay. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. We also offer market leading benefit programs including Medical, Dental and Vision plans, PTO, a 401k retirement plans with employer matching, tuition reimbursement, and more. Pay Range $90,359.53 — $115,561.85 USD ATS is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment to all applicants and employees without regard to age, color, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or other legally protected status. cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:c51.title: Kitchen Assistant (Sur La Table)
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:c51.team: 160 - Classen Curve - Sur La Table, 5854 N Classen Blvd, Oklahoma City, OK 37027
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:c51.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Kitchen Assistant at Sur La Table, you play a key role in inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. With a passion for cooking, hospitality, and teamwork, the Kitchen Assistant supports the chefs to ensure smooth class operations and a #bestincenter experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. You’ll help bring culinary dreams to life by supporting our chefs, engaging with guests, and ensuring a clean, well-organized kitchen environment. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture in both the kitchen and retail sales floor. Sales & Business Performance · Assist chefs with class execution that drives repeat visits and positive customer feedback · Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time · Ability to move about the store directing class participants while selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor · The capability to accurately perceive and differentiate variations in intensity or quality of flavors or odors, or to identify specific tastes or scents using the tongue or nose. · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel and crouch to demonstrate, retrieve and/or replenish merchandise and/or cooking equipment. · Ability to use hands to seize, hold, grasp, turn, or otherwise to chop, whisk, slice, stir, juice and/or demonstrate other techniques. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:130c8d60-cd5.title: Sales Development Representative
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:130c8d60-cd5.description: Wing Assistant is building the next generation of AI-enabled workforce solutions for growing businesses, and our growth depends on a steady flow of qualified sales opportunities. We're hiring a Sales Development Representative to be the tip of that spear: the first person prospective customers meet and the engine that keeps our pipeline full. This is a high-energy, high-ownership seat for someone early in their sales career who wants to learn the craft fast and grow into bigger things. You'll identify companies that are actively hiring for roles Wing can support, reach out with a compelling alternative to traditional hiring, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives. It's a great fit for someone who's competitive, well-organized, motivated by clear targets, and genuinely curious about how AI, remote talent, and global workforce solutions are changing the way companies build teams.
responsibilities: Generate and Qualify Pipeline

Identify companies actively hiring for roles Wing can service, such as Executive Assistants, Admin Assistants, Customer Support, Sales Support, Recruiting Support, Operations Support, and other business support roles.
Research target accounts to understand what they are hiring for, why they may need support, and where Wing could be a strong fit.
Reach out to prospective customers across email, phone, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels.
Run focused outbound campaigns around hiring signals, job postings, company growth, and operational pain points.
Hold early discovery conversations to understand the prospect's hiring needs, pain points, urgency, and openness to remote talent or AI-enabled workforce solutions.
Communicate what Wing Assistant does and why it matters clearly enough to earn the next meeting.
Book qualified appointments for Account Executives with companies that have a clear need, relevant hiring activity, or a strong use case for Wing.
Partner with the Sales Team
Work hand-in-hand with Account Executives to build and protect a healthy, well-qualified pipeline.
Hand off opportunities cleanly, with the context AEs need to move deals forward.
Share key details from discovery calls, including the role the company is hiring for, current hiring process, pain points, timing, budget signals, and decision-makers involved.
Keep activity, notes, and pipeline data accurate and current in our CRM.
Bring the Market Back In
Feed what you're hearing from prospects back to the Sales, Marketing, and Product teams.
Help refine messaging and outreach based on what's actually landing with companies.
Identify patterns in hiring demand, objections, and industries where Wing is resonating.
Suggest new outbound angles based on job postings, hiring trends, and prospect conversations.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:1d7f93a3-8671-.title: Senior SAP Security & GRC Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:1d7f93a3-8671-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior SAP Security & GRC Engineer based in United States. The Senior SAP Security & GRC Engineer will design, implement, and operate security and governance frameworks across complex enterprise SAP environments. The role spans S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Fiori, BTP, SuccessFactors, and related cloud technologies. You will play a critical role in protecting sensitive systems through robust authorization models, access controls, and least-privilege principles. The position combines hands-on SAP GRC engineering with segregation-of-duties analysis, provisioning, audit support, and compliance activities. You will collaborate closely with business process owners, internal audit, Basis, DBA, IAM, and other technology teams. This is an opportunity to strengthen a secure, compliant, and highly auditable SAP landscape while contributing to continuous security improvements. The role is fully remote and suited to an experienced SAP security professional who enjoys solving complex enterprise challenges and sharing expertise with others. Design, implement, and maintain SAP authorization concepts and role structures aligned with business processes, security policies, and least-privilege principles. Build and manage master, derived, composite, and business roles across S/4HANA, ECC, and Fiori environments. Configure and operate SAP GRC Access Control, including Access Risk Analysis (ARA), Access Request Management (ARM), Business Role Management (BRM), and Emergency Access Management (EAM). Manage GRC rulesets, mitigating controls, emergency access processes, and access governance workflows. Perform segregation-of-duties analysis and coordinate remediation activities with business process owners, compliance teams, and internal audit. Configure user provisioning workflows in SAP GRC ARM, including request types, approval paths, and integrations with IAM/IGA platforms. Operate SAP GRC Process Control to support continuous controls monitoring and policy management. Implement and maintain security configurations for SAP Fiori applications, including catalogs, groups, and front-end authorizations. Configure and operate security for SAP BTP and cloud applications using technologies such as XSUAA, IAS, and IPS. Support SOX, GxP, PCI, and other SAP security audits, including evidence collection, finding remediation, and maintenance of documented remediation plans. Implement transport security, table logging, audit logging, and other controls in accordance with enterprise security policies. Monitor SAP Security Notes and coordinate remediation with Basis, DBA, and other technical teams. Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, configuration references, design decisions, runbooks, and operational procedures. Mentor junior security professionals and facilitate knowledge transfer to strengthen the broader SAP security capability. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 5+ years of hands-on SAP Security and GRC experience within complex enterprise SAP environments; the position indicates 10+ years of overall experience as preferred. Deep knowledge of SAP authorization concepts, security architecture, and enterprise role design. Strong hands-on experience with SAP GRC Access Control, particularly ARA, ARM, BRM, and EAM. Demonstrated experience conducting segregation-of-duties analysis, managing mitigating controls, and resolving access risks. Experience supporting SAP audits and developing or executing remediation plans. Hands-on experience securing SAP Fiori, SAP BTP, and cloud-based SAP applications. Familiarity with SAP IDM and/or third-party identity governance and administration platforms. Working knowledge of SAP GRC Process Control and continuous controls monitoring. Strong understanding of regulatory and compliance framework

jobgether-jobgether:lever:b2df2e7a-dab9-.title: Senior Technical Specialist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:b2df2e7a-dab9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Specialist based in United States. This role is ideal for a technically curious customer support professional who enjoys solving complex problems that go beyond standard troubleshooting guides. You will work with customers to diagnose issues across web forms, integrations, conditional logic, styling, and Salesforce-connected workflows. As a senior individual contributor, you will handle challenging cases while becoming a trusted technical resource for the broader support team. You will also help strengthen team capabilities through mentoring, documentation, case reviews, and knowledge sharing. The position offers meaningful exposure to product, engineering, and customer feedback loops. Success requires strong technical investigation skills, clear communication, empathy, and a genuine passion for helping others solve difficult problems. Resolve technically complex customer issues through email and chat while meeting established support and case-quality goals. Diagnose issues across web forms, conditional logic, styling, integrations, and other SaaS functionality rather than relying solely on documented solutions. Troubleshoot Salesforce integrations, including field mappings, error messages, object relationships, and connector configurations. Investigate browser console errors, inspect form configurations and DOM structures, and reproduce issues to identify root causes. Clearly document reproduction steps, severity, technical findings, and relevant context before escalating issues to Tier 2 or Engineering. Monitor support queues and internal communication channels for recurring problems, release-related issues, and emerging trends, escalating patterns proactively. Act as a technical resource for other Support Specialists by answering questions and helping teammates work through complex cases. Mentor newer team members, including through structured onboarding and support buddy programs. Create and improve internal documentation, troubleshooting guides, process notes, and other knowledge resources. Participate in case reviews and contribute to improvements in support quality and consistency. Assist with form moderation and review activities when required. Share customer feedback, recurring issues, and product friction with Support leadership, Product, and Engineering teams. Dedicate time across customer case resolution, team development, training, documentation, and team or departmental meetings. Requirements 2+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing support role, with demonstrated ability to troubleshoot issues beyond documented procedures. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly, accurately, and empathetically. Experience diagnosing issues within web-based SaaS products. Hands-on Salesforce experience as a power user or administrator. Strong HTML knowledge, including the ability to read and interpret form structures, embedded forms, and iFrame publishing. Working knowledge of CSS, including styling conflicts and selector specificity. Ability to read JavaScript errors and understand form logic and dynamic behavior without necessarily developing applications from scratch. Proficiency with browser developer tools for independent error diagnosis and DOM inspection. Experience creating clear technical tickets and bug reports that include reproduction steps and severity assessments. Comfortable working independently in a remote environment with reliable and secure internet access. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a methodical approach to investigating unfamiliar issues. Empathetic and customer-focused approach when supporting users who may be frustrated, confused, or working under deadlines. Ability to recognize recurring patterns and look for underlying causes rather than resolving only individual cases.
